title: A licensee's professional activities must conform with the pharmacy statutes, chapter 94C and the Board's definitions
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(1), a licensee shall conduct professional activities in conformity with M.G.L. c. 112, §§ 24 through 42D, M.G.L. c. 94C, and 247 CMR 2.00: Definitions.
exam_relevance: Tests the affirmative conformity duty a licensee owes and the bodies of law that 247 CMR 9.01(1) names.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
